persona_type_definitions.Spec researcher: Reads reviews and compares specs before buying; won't grab the first result.
persona_type_definitions.Budget grad: Stipend-limited student who wants quality and value, not premium brands.
persona_type_definitions.Home furnisher: Shops home goods often and leans toward nicer brands and materials.
persona_type_definitions.Smart-home tinkerer: Compares whole ecosystems (Ring vs Aqara vs Matter) and buys lots of parts.
persona_type_definitions.Cross-brand comparer: Opens multiple brands in the same category and picks the best deal.
persona_type_definitions.Speed buyer: High budget, low patience — first acceptable listing wins.
persona_type_definitions.Exact-model hunter: Already knows the SKU; searches the full product name and quits if it's not on page 1.
